method_rules.direct_llm: Direct LLM: same hard filter, then local qwen3:4b receives the task and anonymized eligible candidate facts and must return a complete JSON ranking.
method_rules.embedding: Embedding-based: same hard filter; rank eligible candidates by cosine similarity between task text and employee profile/history text. Provider is recorded per run; hashing vectors are synthetic.
method_rules.hybrid: Hybrid: same hard filter; score = .80 * rule score + .20 * embedding cosine. Only eligible candidates are ranked.
method_rules.popularity: Popularity baseline: same hard filter, rank by number of completed history tasks before assignment; ties by on-time rate.
method_rules.random: Random baseline: same hard filter, deterministic per-task shuffle using seed and task ID.
method_rules.rule: Rule-based: hard filter (all required skills level 2+, availability > 0); score = .35 competence + .20 domain/history + .25 availability + .15 past performance + .05 cost. Unknown workload = neutral 0.5 scaled by present working-day share; full leave is excluded.
